line.comment: * SCRIPT NAME: Mayhem.OCVVirus.ResolveTakeover
* DESCRIPTION: Resolves all mature/pending OCV virus takeovers in one sector.
* This script never waits for the current player ship.
* The player ship is marked pending and its own OCV Virus (Task 1329) requests another resolution after the player leaves it.
* See Mayhem.Task.OCVVirus for details.
* AUTHOR: DATE: 29 August 2026
* Validate sector.
* *** Prevent simultaneous resolvers from processing the same sector. ***
* If another resolver is already active, mark that another pass is wanted.
* The active resolver will repeat discovery before releasing the lock.
* Collect ships converted during THIS pass.
* *** Discover every ship in the sector, including arbitrary nested docking. ***
* Seed the array with ships directly docked at stations.
* Walk the docking tree iteratively. Newly discovered ships are also checked.
* *** Find ships eligible for takeover. ***
* Already converted.
* *** Include ships attached to ships being taken over. ***
* Ships either homebased to or physically docked aboard a converting ship are treated as part of that ship's complement.
* Repeat until no additional dependent ships can be found.
* Never propagate takeover to the current player ship.
* Already scheduled for takeover.
* Already OCV.
* Ships homebased to a converting ship convert with it.
* Ships physically docked aboard a converting ship also convert with it.
* Repeated passes handle arbitrary nested docking.
* *** Convert every eligible ship except PLAYERSHIP. ***
* Never directly convert the current player ship. Its own virus remains responsible for retrying after the player leaves.
* *** Normalize docking state. ***
* The ship is being resolved now.
* *** Account for player-owned sacrifice before changing owner. ***
* *** Stop current behavior before takeover. ***
* *** Preserve any clean remainder of the old fleet before ownership changes. ***
* *** Finalize this pass immediately. PLAYERSHIP does not hold this up. ***
* *** Another infection task may have requested resolution while we were working. If so, rediscover from scratch before releasing the lock. ***
* *** Release resolver lock. ***
* Strip and re-equip.
* Transform ships unsuitable for OCV combat.
* TS/TP/TL and special civilian hulls are always replaced.
* Other laserless ships are replaced unless they are missile boats.
* These hulls are always replaced regardless of installed weapons.
* Repair ship is not a combat ship. Ranger is unarmed.
* TS and TP are civilian ships.
* Other laserless ships are replaced, except legitimate missile boats.
* Reset the ship name. Some custom ship names can produce invalid names after takeover.
* Repair to at least 65%.
* OCV boarding defenses. See Mayhem.BuildShip for reference. Does not apply to transformed ships.
* Transforms a ship unsuitable for OCV combat into an OCV combat ship.
* Forced class conversions for civilian ships.
* Select an OCV ship belonging to class. If none exist, use OCV OX.
* Does not randomize to prevent exploits. Will give the worst of the OCV ship class, e.g. a V over a T for M2.
* Should never happen.
* Preserve position, rotation, hull percentage, and quality before replacement.
* Preserve the original ship's orientation.
* Find the first surviving ship that is NOT converting.
* Converting ships cannot inherit the clean fleet.
* No clean survivor.
* Transfer the existing fleet to this member.
* Player sacrifice: reputation loss and notification.
* The player must sacrifice 300 fleet power to the OCV in order to advance the plot.

' empire hates that you lost control of your ships so close to them! ('

line.comment: * Reform OCV forces only if this pass actually converted something.
* Converted ships join the sector's existing OCV force.
* Mayhem.ReformTerraformer handles carrier restocking, grouping, and fleet creation.
